description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'AbstractPubSubSupervisor' that manages the supervision of pub-sub actor components in an Akka-based system. It provides mechanisms for starting child actors, handling child failures with an all-for-one restart strategy, and scheduling restarts. The class also maintains configuration and hash seed data relevant to pub-sub routing.

classes.name: AbstractPubSubSupervisor
classes.description: An abstract Akka actor class that supervises pub-sub actor components, managing their lifecycle, failures, and restarts using a supervision strategy. It also handles configuration and hash seed initialization used for consistent routing.

methods.name: AbstractPubSubSupervisor
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the pub-sub configuration and hash seeds.

methods.name: createPubSubBehavior
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses to define the actor's message handling behavior for pub or sub.

methods.name: onChildFailure
methods.description: Abstract callback invoked when a child actor fails.

methods.name: startChildren
methods.description: Abstract method to start child actors.

methods.name: preStart
methods.description: Lifecycle hook called before the actor starts; it triggers starting child actors.

methods.name: getSeeds
methods.description: Returns the list of hash seeds used for routing.

methods.name: supervisorStrategy
methods.description: Provides an all-for-one supervision strategy with error handling and restart logic.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Defines how the actor handles incoming messages, including pub/sub behavior and restart commands.

methods.name: scheduleRestartChildren
methods.description: Schedules a restart of all child actors after a delay.

methods.name: startChild
methods.description: Starts a new child actor with a unique name based on a prefix; not thread-safe.

methods.name: restartChildren
methods.description: Stops all children and restarts them by invoking startChildren().
